data.title: The core is synchronous and has zero runtime dependencies
data.why: From CLAUDE.md, measured in ADR-003 (DOC-6) and ADR-005 (DOC-8). Asynchronous reading measured 42 ms slower - the CLI does nothing in parallel anyway. A validation library cost 15% of the startup budget for a seven-field object. So ULID generation and validation are hand-rolled.
data.rejected: An asynchronous core: 42 ms slower on the same journal; A schema validation library: 15% of the startup budget to validate a seven-field object
